name: CUDA Volume Ray Casting
definition: A CUDA kernel that performs volume ray casting, reading from a transfer function texture and writing the composited color and opacity to a surface object, optionally using pre-computed front/back hit positions from OpenGL or computing them via inverse view matrix.
summary: CUDA Volume Ray Casting is a direct volume rendering method that parallelizes ray casting on NVIDIA GPUs via CUDA, offering explicit memory control and performance gains over standard OpenGL shaders.
